capacitor-a#0.notes: chunky sky-blue can with cream stripe and silver legs; reads at 1x on light and dark; slight top dome is acceptable for an icon

chip-a#0.notes: navy chip with even pins and a yellow robot face; crisp, symmetric, reads at 1x

coil-a#0.notes: copper-wound toroid with mint core, symmetric ring; reads at 1x on light and dark

capacitor-mini-a#0.notes: squat wide can reads as a bucket or pot, not the tall capacitor; too wide for the 18x24 slot

capacitor-mini-b#0.notes: tall sky-blue can with cream stripe and legs matches the big icon; reads at 1x; fits 18x24

chip-mini-a#0.notes: navy square with pins on four sides and a yellow centre; clearly a chip at 1x (pin colours vary, acceptable at this size)

coil-mini-a#0.notes: clean copper ring with a hole; reads as the coil at 1x on light and dark

coil-mini-b#0.notes: concentric rainbow stripes are noisy at 1x; the ring shape is lost
